title: Total-Loss Deductible Waiver for Long-Standing Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Policyholders
content:
**Benefit terms.** On a total-loss vehicle surrendered under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, where the inception date of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy is at least 120 whole months before the loss date and the vehicle's coverage shows no claim closed as paid within the last 36 months, the deductible charge is nothing; where the inception date is at least 120 whole months before the loss date and exactly one such claim shows, the deductible charge is 80 percent of the decided deductible, rounded to the cent; otherwise the deductible charge is the decided deductible.

The decided deductible is the deductible stated on the claim's latest accepted coverage decision. The inception date is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record; the claims closed as paid are the claim closings of the vehicle's coverage whose closing reason is paid, within the last 36 months.

## Tiers

| Whole months from inception to the loss date | Claims of the coverage closed as paid within the last 36 months | Deductible charge |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | None | Nothing |
| 120 or more | Exactly one | 80 percent of the decided deductible, rounded to the cent |
| 120 or more | Two or more | The decided deductible |
| Fewer than 120 | Any | The decided deductible |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical figures, decided deductible 750.00)

- 120 whole months, no paid claim closed in the last 36 months: charge 0.00.
- 120 whole months, one paid claim closed in the last 36 months: 80 percent of 750.00, that is 600.00.
- 120 whole months, two paid claims closed in that period: 750.00.
- 119 whole months, no paid claim: 750.00.
